raw_text: Vendor guarantees 98% fleet uptime. Critical pressure alerts must be resolved within 12 hours.

contract_text:
MASTER FLEET SERVICES AGREEMENT — H02
Schedule H02/Service Level Exhibit | Service Tier: Standard Fleet

1. SERVICE STANDARD. The Provider shall furnish continuous fleet support for the Customer's covered commercial vehicles. Subject to the exclusions and remedies stated herein, monthly fleet uptime shall be maintained at not less than 97% and each Critical Event shall be restored to operational status within 10 hours of validated notification. Critical Events are those that materially disable the vehicle or prevent safe dispatch.

2. MEASUREMENT & REPORTING. Uptime shall be calculated from Provider telemetry and validated incident records. Planned maintenance windows approved in writing at least 24 hours in advance shall be excluded. Provider shall retain relevant service records and make them available upon reasonable audit request.

3. REMEDIES. A failure to satisfy a stated service level constitutes an SLA exception and may result in service credits, corrective-action requirements, or other remedies expressly available under the commercial terms.

Schedule B05/Service Level Exhibit | Service Tier: Standard Fleet

1. SERVICE STANDARD. The Provider shall furnish continuous fleet support for the Customer's covered commercial vehicles. Subject to the exclusions and remedies stated herein, monthly fleet uptime shall be maintained at not less than 96% and each Critical Event shall be restored to operational status within 12 hours of validated notification. For avoidance of doubt, the numerical service levels in this Schedule are binding and are not aspirational.

2. MEASUREMENT & REPORTING. Uptime shall be calculated from Provider telemetry and validated incident records. Planned maintenance windows approved in writing at least 24 hours in advance shall be excluded. Provider shall retain relevant service records and make them available upon reasonable audit request.

3. REMEDIES. A failure to satisfy a stated service level constitutes an SLA exception and may result in service credits, corrective-action requirements, or other remedies expressly available under the commercial terms.

contract_text:
MASTER FLEET SERVICES AGREEMENT — C02
Schedule C02/Service Level Exhibit | Service Tier: Premium Fleet

1. SERVICE LEVEL. The Provider shall maintain monthly fleet uptime of at least 99% and shall restore any Critical Event within 6 hours following validated notification.

2. OPERATING CONDITIONS. Planned maintenance approved in writing shall be excluded from downtime calculations. Critical Events shall be logged through the agreed incident-management process, and the Provider shall preserve telemetry and repair records for audit purposes.

3. ADDENDUM / LATER COMMERCIAL NOTE. Notwithstanding Section 1, the parties agree that a Critical Event may be resolved within 12 hours of notification. This provision is stated as an amendment to the repair obligation above; all other service levels remain unchanged.

4. REMEDIES. Service credits and corrective action shall apply to verified failures of the applicable service levels.

MASTER FLEET SERVICES AGREEMENT — A01
Schedule A01/Service Level Exhibit | Service Tier: Standard Fleet

1. RESPONSE STANDARD. The Provider shall maintain reliable fleet availability and shall ensure that Critical Events are repaired timely, industry-standard manner. The Provider shall use commercially reasonable efforts to minimize vehicle downtime and shall prioritize safety-critical incidents.

2. INTERPRETATION. The parties acknowledge that operational circumstances, parts availability, site access, and vehicle condition may affect repair duration. No fixed numerical response or repair period is stated in this Schedule.

3. REPORTING. Provider shall record event timestamps, diagnostic findings, repair actions, and return-to-service status and shall provide records upon reasonable Customer request.
